title: 2002 HMMT February General Round 2 Problem 6
statement: Nine nonnegative numbers have average 10 . What is the greatest possible value for their median?

solutions.text: 18 If the median is \(m\), then the five highest numbers are all at least \(m\), so the sum of all the numbers is at least \(5 m\). Thus \(90 \geq 5 m \Rightarrow m \leq 18\). Conversely, we can achieve \(m=18\) by taking four 0's and five 18's.
